adapterCapabilities.unpricedUsage: Unknown cost stays unpriced, not zero. Credits are not USD; no reliable monetary conversion is claimed.
adapterCapabilities.remoteOnly: This bridge uses the cloud API; it does not control an installed WorkBuddy desktop client.
adapterCapabilities.workbuddyRemote: OAuth/job/ACP/report contracts have controlled tests. Real app approval, account and cloud task remain unverified.
adapterCapabilities.workbuddySession: Persisted job/session recovery is fixture-tested. Unknown creates are not blindly repeated.
adapterCapabilities.noRemoteStop: Stopping the local bridge does not prove that the remote provider stopped.
adapterCapabilities.denyToolApproval: Permission requests are denied by default; no qualified human-approval round trip.

wecomUi.title: WeCom receive connections
wecomUi.boundary: Receive-only, quarantined feedback. No replies, test sends, model calls or global worker controls.
wecomUi.noReplay: No replay or historical completeness guarantee. A gap flag is not repaired by refreshing.
wecomUi.denied: Access or read failed. Private data and controls are hidden; sign in with an authorized administrator session.
wecomUi.limit: At most 100 connections, newest created first. Redacted status only; configuration cannot be reconstructed or edited here.
wecomUi.enableWarning: Enabling CAN CONNECT to WeCom and receive allowed messages when global worker gates permit. This is not a connection test or proof of delivery.
wecomUi.disableWarning: Disabling stops this receive connection. In-flight work may settle; missing messages cannot be replayed.
wecomUi.confirmChange: I explicitly confirm this enable/disable operation.
wecomUi.registrar: Only an instance administrator may register. The server checks current authority and Bot ownership must be verified separately. Company administrators manage existing connections.
wecomUi.scopeHelp: One explicit ID per line, maximum 100 each. At least one group or direct sender is required; no wildcard or all-history scope.
wecomUi.pinHelp: Only active, undeleted company secrets. The number is a frozen pin, never a moving latest reference. The server validates version status; no secret value is loaded or created.
wecomUi.confirmRegister: I verified ownership and scopes and confirm registration DISABLED, without connecting.
wecomUi.registered: Registered disabled. No connection was started by registration.
wecomUi.updated: State saved. Refresh to inspect worker status; not a delivery guarantee.
wecomUi.rejected: Request rejected. Review current state and authority before any new operation.
wecomUi.unknown: Response uncertain: do NOT repeat the POST. Refresh manually and reconcile with an administrator. Redacted lists cannot prove Bot identity; no configuration details are available here.
